Business.heroDesc: Explore SIGNAL's B2B pipeline, directly planned and closely managed by incumbent Korean education experts with over 15 years of experience.
Business.biz1Desc: We safely connect students from overseas institutions to language programs, bachelor's, and master's degree courses at major Korean universities. Experts with over 15 years of university experience, including former head instructors, directly manage everything from complex visa administration to customized local coaching.
Business.biz1List1: MOU-based connection to language programs & degrees at 4-year universities
Business.biz1List2: Building B2B pipelines for local study abroad agencies and agents
Business.biz1List3: Customized coaching for early settlement and successful study abroad life
Business.biz2Desc: We plan and operate 100% customized short-term training programs tailored to the schedules and needs of our overseas partner institutions. It is a premium educational tour combining practical Korean conversation, top university tours, and specialized K-Culture field trips.
Business.biz2List1: 1-4 week intensive conversation and specialized course design
Business.biz2List2: Campus tours of top universities and customized corporate/industrial site visits
Business.biz2List3: Budget-tailored accommodation arrangement and close accompaniment by field experts
Business.biz3Desc: SIGNAL combines 15 years of field education know-how with IT capabilities. To ensure high TOPIK scores and smooth academic operations, we provide partner institutions with our proprietary mobile learning web and student/class management solutions.
Business.biz3List2: Grade and attendance management dashboard integration for administrators
Business.biz3List3: Interactive class-related web programs to increase learning efficiency

Consulting.heroDesc: From complex visa processing to close field care after arrival, partner institutions can focus purely on student recruitment. SIGNAL takes full responsibility for the rest.
Consulting.compDesc: Three overwhelming competitive advantages built on years of field experience in university language institutes and international offices.
Consulting.comp1Desc: We minimize D-4 and D-2 visa rejection rates through meticulous preliminary document review by country and close communication with university international offices.
Consulting.comp2Desc: We guarantee the fastest and most accurate issuance of standard admission letters through direct partnerships with major 4-year universities in Seoul and the metropolitan area.
Consulting.comp3Desc: We directly accompany and support the A-to-Z necessary for students' initial settlement, including airport pickup, dormitory check-in, alien registration, and bank account opening.
Consulting.procDesc: A systematic student dispatch roadmap designed together by partner institutions and SIGNAL.
Consulting.proc4Desc2: Close care support for early settlement
Consulting.coachDesc: Beyond simple admission, SIGNAL's exclusive 1:1 career coaching takes responsibility from language programs to undergraduate/master's degrees.
Consulting.coach1List1: Monitoring attendance and mid/final exam grades
Consulting.coach1List2: 1:1 counseling and motivation for underperforming students
Consulting.coach1List3: Short-term intensive TOPIK coaching using our EdTech app
Consulting.coach2List1: Recommending optimal majors/universities tailored to aptitude
Consulting.coach2List2: Analyzing admission guidelines for international students & preparing docs
Consulting.coach2List3: Editing personal statements, study plans, and mock interviews
Consulting.coach3List1: Mentoring to overcome psychological difficulties like homesickness
Consulting.coach3List2: Guidance on legal part-time work visa permissions
Consulting.coach3List3: Guide to domestic employment (E-7) and job seeking (D-10) post-graduation
Consulting.settleDesc: SIGNAL's premium in-house service accompanying students with the heart of a family.
Consulting.settle1Desc: We provide exclusive vehicle pickups upon arrival at Incheon Airport and ensure safety by accompanying students during dormitory and studio apartment check-ins.
Consulting.settle2Desc: We support cumbersome government tasks, from booking visits to the immigration office and preparing necessary documents to accompanying them on-site.
Consulting.settle3Desc: We perfectly set up essential initial living needs, including opening a Korean bank account, issuing a debit card, and activating a smartphone SIM.
Consulting.settle4Desc: In the event of sudden illness or injury, we accompany students to nearby hospitals to assist with interpretation and support necessary insurance claims.

Program.feat2Desc: Arrangement of optimal accommodations and deployment of field-leading experts matched to your needs
